description: I am passionate about aeronautical engineering and space technology. My interests include manmade satellites, astrophysics, AI and machine learning, space exploration, web development and game development.
summary: Our project is an interactive 3D Space Mission Simulator designed to make space exploration more engaging and educational. It allows users to experience the process of planning and carrying out a space mission through a virtual environment. Users can explore missions to destinations like the Moon and Mars, customize spacecraft components, manage mission requirements and test whether their designs are suitable for the journey.
details:
Our project is a browser-based 3D space mission simulator that gives users an opportunity to experience different stages of space exploration. Instead of simply reading about space missions, users can interact with a virtual environment and understand what goes into planning and completing a mission.

The simulator allows users to choose destinations such as the Moon and Mars, work with spacecraft components, adjust different mission settings and check whether their spacecraft meets the requirements for the journey. It also includes a mission planning system, flight simulation, telemetry readings and a final mission report. These features help users understand how different decisions can affect the outcome of a space mission.

One of the main benefits of our project is that it makes complex space exploration concepts easier to understand through interaction and visual learning. It can help students and space enthusiasts develop a better understanding of spacecraft systems, mission planning and the challenges of exploring other planets.

We developed the project using JavaScript and React for the application, Three.js with React Three Fiber and Drei for the 3D environment, and Vite as the development tool. We also used CSS to create the interface and design the overall experience.

What makes our project creative is the way it combines an interactive 3D environment with mission planning and simulation features in one platform. We focused on making the experience visually engaging while also considering usability, performance, different screen sizes and the educational value of the simulator.

Our main aim was to turn the idea of space exploration into something people can actually interact with, experiment with and learn from.
